title: Lumbar L4-L5 motion segments in axial compression - Asano et al. 1992 (Spine 17:1343) force at 0.5, 1.0, 1.5 mm (secondary, Ghezelbash 2020a Fig 4a)

quantity.name: axial compression force-displacement curve
quantity.definition: axial compressive force at 0.5, 1.0 and 1.5 mm axial displacement (square markers) as plotted by Ghezelbash 2020a

source.authors: Ghezelbash F, Shirazi-Adl A, Baghani M, Eskandari AH
source.sample: not stated in the secondary source (see primary: Asano S, Kaneda K, Umehara S, Tadano S 1992, Spine 17:1343-1352); human L4-L5 functional spinal units, intact (posterior elements present), cyclic loading

protocol.summary: Cyclic compression-tension of intact L4-L5 FSUs (Asano et al. 1992); rate and preload not given in the secondary source. Legend of Fig 4a reads "Asano et al. (1999)"; the caption and reference list give 1992.
how_to_simulate: Model an intact L4-L5 motion segment; fix the lower vertebra
Report the compressive force at 0.5, 1.0 and 1.5 mm axial displacement
protocol.notes: Secondary data: digitised from a figure of Ghezelbash et al. 2020a (the owner's FE validation band; also Fig 2c of Ghezelbash 2025 bioRxiv). Primary paper not in the repository. Error bars are drawn but not defined; not extracted as SD.

data.note: error bar about +/-80 N drawn at 1.5 mm (type not stated)

extraction.from: Ghezelbash 2020a Fig 4a (lime square markers); same data form the 'Experiment' band of Ghezelbash 2025 bioRxiv Fig 2c
extraction.uncertainty: +/-0.01 mm, +/-30 N; where curves overlap below 0.3 mm: +/-60 N
extraction.check_notes: Page rendered at 600 dpi; axes from tick marks (831 px/mm, 0.302 px/N); curves found by colour (green = Brown, red = Markolf & Morris, lime squares = Asano) in column scans every 0.025-0.1 mm, line style (solid/dashed/dash-dot) assigned by continuity and checked against a gridded zoom. Values are the review authors' plot of the primary data, not the primary paper.

pass_rule.rule: model curve inside the min-max envelope (or within +/-25% of the curve)
